content.title: Acushnet (NYSE:GOLF) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q3
content.summary: Golf equipment and apparel company Acushnet (NYSE:GOLF) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6% year on year to $657.7 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.53 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.81 per share was 5.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
